text:
maria: Quick heads-up: while debugging onboarding flow I saw unredacted PII in logs from the node sampleapp when LOG_LEVEL=debug. Looks like request IDs are being duplicated and redactor is skipped intermittently.

sam: Oof. Is this the asyncLocalStorage stomp we saw before? Any 3rd-party libs that might call enterWith/run?

maria: node 18.16, sampleapp@1.4.7. deps include somemetrics@2.3.1 and tracing-utils@0.9. Repro with /scripts/loadtest.js at ~40 concurrency.

lee: paste a log snippet and middleware order. Our otel-hook ordering is sensitive.

maria: snippet:```
[2026-03-22T09:12:03Z] INFO reqid=abc123 route=/v1/generate payload={"email":"alice@example.com","text":"hi"}
[2026-03-22T09:12:03Z] ERROR reqid=abc123 stack="Error: boom at handler"
[2026-03-22T09:12:03Z] DEBUG reqid=abc123 redactor=skipped payload={"phone":"+15551234"}
```

maria: middleware in index.js:```js
app.use(require('./reqid'))
app.use(require('./otel-hook'))
app.use(require('./redactor'))
```

ash: sounds like otel-hook or somemetrics is doing enterWith and stomping our map. Two options: move otel-hook earlier so it owns context, or in reqid use als.run(...) to pin reqid.

sam: also emit a metric when redactor sees no reqid instead of silently regenerating. Helps Optimize alerting.

lee: patch idea: in reqid middleware use:
```js
const als = require('./als')
als.run(new Map([['reqid', reqid]]), () => next())
```
and in redactor:```js
const reqid = als.get('reqid') || 'volatile-'+shortid()
if (reqid.startsWith('volatile-')) metrics.increment('volatile_reqid')
```

jen: QA reproduced in staging. We'll run the loadtest and confirm.

maria: opened PR #1223: swaps otel-hook earlier, switches to als.run, adds volatile_reqid metric, and adds an e2e that asserts no raw emails/phones at concurrency. Repro script at /scripts/loadtest.js.

sam: add an integ test that loads a fake lib that calls enterWith to prevent regressions. Also add linter rule to forbid direct asyncLocalStorage.enterWith outside our wrapper.

ash: mitigation: set LOG_LEVEL=info on Dedicated until patch lands: `kubectl set env deploy/sampleapp LOG_LEVEL=info -n dedicated`

telemetry-bot: sampleapp/staging v1.4.7 -> deploy success :white_check_mark: (build 8842)

maria: will add the linter, integ test, and changelog note about OTEL hook ordering and the volatile_reqid metric. tagging @sam @lee for review.

sam: reviewing today; if green we'll backport to 1.3.x.

jen: QA will smoke after merge and verify no PII in logs.

lee: follow-up: add e2e that asserts each log line either has a redacted payload or matches info-only pattern. prevents silent regressions.

maria: agreed, adding that too. thanks everyone.
